# X3 Software Update Program

**Author:** TTPCom Limited<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

<div className="screenshot">

![X3 Software Update Program: screenshot 1](./x3-software-update-program/img/x3-software-update-program.png)

</div>

TTPCom FLASH430 service program for Siemens ODM-series phones. Uploads firmware in MOT, BIF, and BIN formats, erases flash memory, verifies the checksum, and lets you read a specified memory range into a file.
